note: The environment record for ONE clean M3 acceptance run (new world, new seed, no assists). This file is BOTH the operator environment record for `tools/m3-acceptance-bundle.mjs --environment <this file>` (readEnvironmentFile reads `values`/`worldChanges`) AND the clean-run premise checked by `tools/clean-run-gate.mjs`. It is a TEMPLATE until `cleanRun.sourceSha.state` is FROZEN: `bun tools/clean-run-prepare.mjs --environment <this file> --source-sha <frozen-40-hex> --apply` writes a resolved copy next to the prepared world. A descriptor that is not frozen can never authorise a clean run (see `cleanRun.sourceSha.policy`).

cleanRun.requirement: Nether 到達を live で証明する(M3達成はnew seed new world、keepinvなどの補助ゼロで証明すること。実験は今のワールドで良い。)

previousWorld.why: measured 2026-09-23: difficulty=normal, level-name=world, level-seed=2024, keepInventory ON (proved by behaviour: LADDER_INVENTORY_SETTLE reason=death itemCount=27 with the diamond_sword surviving). level.dat confirms keep_inventory=true in ALL THREE dimensions and advance_time=false in the overworld. The server .console_history records the assists verbatim: gamerule keep_inventory true (and twice via `execute in minecraft:the_nether/the_end run gamerule keep_inventory true`), spawn_mobs false/true toggles, advance_time false, doDaylightCycle false, doInsomnia false, forced night and clear weather, 7x tp, 27x give (incl. cobblestone 402 and diamond gear), 4x fill ... air replace (portal/obsidian). No `seed` command was ever run, so the seed is only in server.properties. This world can never be the M3 proof.

sourceSha.policy: Frozen at clean-run time: `bun tools/clean-run-prepare.mjs --environment tools/fixtures/m3-clean-environment.json --source-sha <40-hex> --apply` (or --root <frozen checkout>, which resolves git HEAD) writes the resolved descriptor. A placeholder/stale SHA is a FAIL (descriptor.sourceSha) because the run must boot EXACTLY the frozen commit; keeping it unset in git is what stops a stale pin from silently authorising a run.

gamerulePolicy.rule: Every gamerule is at its vanilla default. Any deviation is an assist unless the operator records it here as an explicit exception AND the clean-run gate is given that exception (there is no exception mechanism on purpose: a clean M3 run has none). An omitted mandatory rule is a FAIL, not a default, and every declared rule must carry a justification below.
gamerulePolicy.defaultsSource: measured 2026-09-23 from this build: GameRules.<clinit> of the running Leaf jar (versions/1.21.11/leaf-1.21.11.jar sha256 7bcb251c...cc084) and of the pure Mojang vanilla jar (cache/mojang_1.21.11.jar!...server-1.21.11.jar inner sha256 ec47239a...fcebc) - 59/59 names and values identical, plus a javap -p -c cross-check with 0 mismatches, plus the live worlds' own Data.game_rules (58 rules). The extraction scripts and raw JSON lived under the gitignored runs/m3-clean-measure/ tree (a local, read-only measurement of the server on this machine); the table above is the committed canonical copy and can be re-derived from the named jar + class with the same static parse. The live worlds carry 58 of the 59 rules (max_minecart_speed is feature-flagged off in this world).

notRegisteredInWorld.max_minecart_speed: registered by this build but ABSENT from every world because its feature flag (minecart_improvements) is in the world datapack disabled list, so the `gamerule max_minecart_speed ...` command does not exist in-world; it is declared at its default but excluded from the written datapack/console set

assistIfChanged.advance_time: false pins the overworld clock (the live world runs it false): spawn timing, enderman behaviour and visibility all change with the day/night cycle.
assistIfChanged.advance_weather: false freezes the weather; weather affects visibility, lightning and crop hydration - a tuned world.
assistIfChanged.allow_entering_nether_using_portals: false would forbid Nether portal travel entirely - M3 is defined by reaching the Nether.
assistIfChanged.block_drops: false removes block drops (obsidian, flint, wood, stone): the whole M2->M3 material chain assumes blocks drop items.
assistIfChanged.block_explosion_drop_decay: false makes every block explosion drop all blocks - a free resource source.
assistIfChanged.command_block_output: false hides command-block output from the log; the acceptance must not run with an evidence surface degraded.
assistIfChanged.command_blocks_work: false changes command-block behaviour; command blocks are also an operator-intervention surface.
assistIfChanged.drowning_damage: false makes water/underwater traversal free: an assist, not a preference.
assistIfChanged.elytra_movement_check: false removes the elytra movement check, i.e. it changes movement validation for the body.
assistIfChanged.ender_pearls_vanish_on_death: false lets the body keep ender pearls through a death - a direct assist towards the 12-eye predicate.
assistIfChanged.entity_drops: false removes entity drops (leather, string, and the pearl/rod class of drops): a tuned world.
assistIfChanged.fall_damage: false makes the most common embodied failure (a fall) free, removing the survival pressure the acceptance proves.
assistIfChanged.fire_damage: false makes lava/fire harmless in the Nether, the primary hazard of the M3 route.
assistIfChanged.fire_spread_radius_around_player: the 1.21.x successor of doFireTick; any other value changes fire spread/extinguish around the body.
assistIfChanged.forgive_dead_players: false makes zombified piglins stay angry forever after a death: a non-default mob-behaviour rule.
assistIfChanged.freeze_damage: false removes powder-snow/freezing damage; the world must behave like a normal world.
assistIfChanged.global_sound_events: a non-default value changes how world events are broadcast (diagnostic surface only).
assistIfChanged.immediate_respawn: true removes the death screen/respawn delay; the run must pay the normal cost of dying.
assistIfChanged.keep_inventory: items survive death: the body never has to re-acquire a lost kit. PROVED ON in the live world (LADDER_INVENTORY_SETTLE reason=death itemCount=27 with the diamond_sword surviving), so this is the assist the whole harness exists to exclude.
assistIfChanged.lava_source_conversion: true creates infinite lava sources - a free obsidian/cobblestone factory, directly assisting the M2->M3 chain.
assistIfChanged.limited_crafting: true restricts crafting to unlocked recipes, i.e. it changes what the agent may craft.
assistIfChanged.locator_bar: a non-default value degrades a position/diagnostic surface the reviewer can read.
assistIfChanged.log_admin_commands: false hides admin commands from the log, i.e. it can conceal exactly the operator interventions a clean run must have none of.
assistIfChanged.max_block_modifications: a non-default command modification budget is a mechanics change and an operator-intervention surface.
assistIfChanged.max_command_forks: a non-default command fork budget is a mechanics change and an operator-intervention surface.
assistIfChanged.max_command_sequence_length: a non-default command-sequence length is a mechanics change and an operator-intervention surface.
assistIfChanged.max_entity_cramming: a non-default cramming limit changes mob-farm and mob-push behaviour, which the survival route can exploit.
assistIfChanged.max_minecart_speed: a non-default minecart speed is a movement-mechanics change (and a tuned transport shortcut).
assistIfChanged.max_snow_accumulation_height: a non-default snow height is a world-mechanics change (mobility and visibility).
assistIfChanged.mob_drops: false removes mob drops, i.e. exactly the ender pearls and blaze rods the milestone is made of.
assistIfChanged.mob_explosion_drop_decay: false changes mob-explosion drops; a non-default value is a tuned resource source.
assistIfChanged.mob_griefing: false disables creeper/ghast/enderman terrain damage, i.e. it removes real hazards and world mutation.
assistIfChanged.natural_health_regeneration: false removes passive healing; a deviation (harder or easier) must never enter the acceptance world silently.
assistIfChanged.player_movement_check: false disables the player movement check, i.e. it changes movement validation for the body.
assistIfChanged.players_nether_portal_creative_delay: the creative-mode portal delay must stay vanilla so no mode-specific shortcut exists.
assistIfChanged.players_nether_portal_default_delay: a shortened portal delay makes Nether transit faster than the vanilla rule - a direct assist to the M3 route.
assistIfChanged.players_sleeping_percentage: a lower value lets one player skip the night for free; 100 is the vanilla rule.
assistIfChanged.projectiles_can_break_blocks: false removes projectile block-breaking: a mechanics change the Nether route can feel.
assistIfChanged.pvp: a non-default PvP rule is a server-mechanics change (and the body is the only player).
assistIfChanged.raids: false disables raids - a hostile-event rule that changes the danger model of the world.
assistIfChanged.random_tick_speed: any other value changes crop growth, fire spread, ice/snow melt and leaf decay - it rewrites world physics for the run.
assistIfChanged.reduced_debug_info: true hides debug information; the acceptance must not run with evidence surfaces degraded.
assistIfChanged.respawn_radius: a tiny respawn radius controls exactly where the body respawns; a huge one changes spawn randomness. Either is a tuned start.
assistIfChanged.send_command_feedback: false hides command results, i.e. it degrades the operator-verification surface for gamerules and seed.
assistIfChanged.show_advancement_messages: false hides advancement broadcasts - a diagnostic surface the reviewer reads.
assistIfChanged.show_death_messages: false hides death broadcasts - a diagnostic surface the reviewer reads.
assistIfChanged.spawn_mobs: false suppresses natural mob spawning, so there are no endermen (pearls) and no blazes (rods) - the two inputs of M3.
assistIfChanged.spawn_monsters: false suppresses hostile spawning specifically; M3 is built on hostile-mob drops.
assistIfChanged.spawn_patrols: false suppresses pillager patrols - a hostile-spawn rule the operator must not tune for a proof run.
assistIfChanged.spawn_phantoms: false suppresses phantoms; the run should face the world it claims to survive in.
assistIfChanged.spawn_wandering_traders: false suppresses wandering traders (free leads/items); a changed spawn rule is an assist surface.
assistIfChanged.spawn_wardens: false suppresses wardens/deep-dark spawning; a spawn-rule deviation changes the danger model of mining.
assistIfChanged.spawner_blocks_work: false disables mob spawners; the world stops behaving normally (the route can meet structure spawners).
assistIfChanged.spectators_generate_chunks: a non-default chunk-generation rule is a world-mechanics change.
assistIfChanged.spread_vines: a non-default vine-spread rule is a world-mechanics change.
assistIfChanged.tnt_explodes: false disables TNT explosions - a world-mechanics change.
assistIfChanged.tnt_explosion_drop_decay: true would delete TNT-explosion drops; a non-default value is a mechanics change.
assistIfChanged.universal_anger: true makes zombified piglins permanently angry; it rewrites Nether mob behaviour.
assistIfChanged.water_source_conversion: false breaks normal fluid behaviour (and with it every water-clutch/water-elevator mechanic).

gameruleScope.why: measured: gamerules are stored PER DIMENSION (each level.dat owns its own Data.game_rules; the live world runs keep_inventory=true in all three while advance_time=false only in the overworld). A load function runs in the overworld context, so the gamerule datapack asserts every rule in all three dimensions - otherwise keep_inventory could stay true in the Nether, i.e. exactly where the M3 route dies.

gameruleMechanism.primaryDetail: After the FIRST boot of the clean world the operator runs `gamerule`, and `execute in minecraft:the_nether run gamerule` plus `execute in minecraft:the_end run gamerule`, on the server console and pastes the three listings into gamerule-verification.txt under their prepared dimension headers. The clean-run gate binds the transcript to the exact runId, resolved descriptor SHA, levelName, seed and BOOT source SHA, then checks keep_inventory=false and every declared default in ALL THREE dimensions. This remains operator-captured evidence: Mineflayer cannot read gamerules or independently authenticate console origin. camelCase ids are rejected by this build (ids are snake_case).
gameruleMechanism.secondaryDetail: clean-run-prepare writes <world>/datapacks/m3-clean-gamerules with data/minecraft/tags/function/load.json -> m3clean:set_gamerules, so every rule is asserted at every world load in all three dimensions. The load tag is auto-enabled even with initial-enabled-packs=vanilla (measured).

datapackFormat.source: measured from this build: version.json data_major=94/data_minor=1; the server writes world/datapacks/bukkit/pack.mcmeta with {"min_format":[94,1],"max_format":[94,1]} and the bundled paper datapack uses {"min_format":94,"max_format":94}. Since 1.21.9 a bare pack_format does not declare support.

assists.declaration: How this world was made: a fresh level-name + fresh level-seed generated by the server itself on first boot. No /give, no /summon, no /fill, no /setblock, no /effect, no structure placement, no operator-built machine, no pre-lit portal. If any of the lists below is non-empty the descriptor is NOT_CLEAN.
